title: Avengers: Doomsday Will Open in India a Day Before the US, Marvel Confirms in Diwali Surprise
excerpt: Robert Downey Jr. and Chris Evans announced in a Marvel India Diwali video that the film releases in Indian theatres on December 17, 2026 — a day ahead of the US — in English, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu.
body:
• Avengers: Doomsday will release in Indian theatres on December 17, 2026, one day ahead of its US release on December 18.
  • The film will be available in English, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu.
  • Robert Downey Jr., returning as Doctor Doom, and Chris Evans, back as Steve Rogers, announced the date in a Marvel India Diwali video.
  • The film is directed by Anthony and Joe Russo and is the first Avengers release since Endgame in 2019, which grossed $2.80 billion worldwide.

India will see the next Avengers film before the United States does. Marvel Studios confirmed that Avengers: Doomsday will release in Indian theatres on December 17, 2026, a day ahead of its scheduled US release on December 18, with the announcement delivered as a Diwali message to Indian fans.

Robert Downey Jr. and Chris Evans — who return to the Marvel Cinematic Universe as Doctor Doom and Steve Rogers respectively — fronted the special video released by Marvel India. "Namaste India! What we love about Diwali is it marks the closing of one chapter and beginning of another… that's something we know a lot about," the actors said, according to Cinema Express.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=irVNGjRFZGk

"Except instead of moving from dark to light, I think it might be going in the other direction."

— Robert Downey Jr., in Marvel India's Diwali video

A market Marvel is courting openly

The early release, announced exactly 50 days before the Indian opening, positions India as a first-wave market for the studio's biggest title in years. The film will release in English, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu, and reports indicate an extended four-day opening weekend in India. Downey Jr.'s return is the central casting event: after a decade as Tony Stark, he comes back as the villain Victor von Doom. Evans reprises Steve Rogers, the former Captain America, for the first time since Endgame.

https://x.com/KomalNahta/status/2115397903187599525

Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, Doomsday brings together heroes from across the MCU — the ensemble includes Chris Hemsworth, Pedro Pascal, Paul Rudd, Anthony Mackie, Florence Pugh, Vanessa Kirby, Simu Liu, Ian McKellen, Hayley Atwell, Tom Hiddleston and Patrick Stewart — as characters from different corners of the franchise face an existential threat, The Hollywood Reporter India reported.

The bar the film has to clear

The last Avengers release was Avengers: Endgame in 2019, which rose to $2.80 billion worldwide — second only to Avatar at $2.92 billion. No Avengers film has opened since, making Doomsday both a reunion event and a test of whether the franchise's event-film pull survived the post-Endgame years. The Diwali-timed courtship of India — a market where dubbed versions in Hindi, Tamil and Telugu substantially widen a Hollywood tentpole's reach — is part of that bet.

For diaspora audiences in the US, the sequencing cuts the other way: American theatres open the film a day later, on December 18, so anyone wanting to avoid spoilers from Indian opening-day reactions will need to be careful online on December 17.
